To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Hall current, rotation parameter, and visco-elastic parameter have a significant impact on the velocity, temperature, skin-friction coefficient, and Nusselt Number.
the skin friction and heat transfer rate increase as the Hall current and the rotation parameter increase.

the velocity, temperature, and concentration profiles increase with an increase in the magnetic field parameter, the Hall current parameter and the rotation parameter and the opposite trend is observed when these parameters are decreased.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the transient MHD flow of a vis-coelastic fluid (Walters B’) past an inclined porous plate embedded in an infinite porous medium with Hall effect and slip condition in the presence of a uniform rotating magnetic field when the plate temperature is varying with time.

the study of the effect of Hall current and slip boundary conditions on the MHD flow of a vis-coelastic fluid past an infinitely long vertical porous plate embedded into a porous medium in a rotating system, which has not been studied in the literature before, to the best of the authors’ knowledge.
the transient MHD flow of a viscoe-elastic fluid ( Walter’s B’) past a vertical porous plate embedded within a porous medium with the Hall current effect.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present analysis is useful in understanding the transient MHD flow of a viscoe-elastic fluid ( Walter’s B’) past a porous plate embedded in porous medium with Hall effect and slip condition in rotating systems.
the present work has provided a complete theoretical analysis of the problem and has shown the effects of the physical parameters on the flow field.

the Hall current, rotation parameter, magnetic field parameter, Prandtl number, Schmidt number and the slip parameter have a significant influence on the velocity, temperature and concentration fields, coefficient of skin friction, Nusselt number and Sherwood number.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

it is possible to obtain the exact solution of the present problem and it is possible to analyze the effects of Hall current, rotation parameter, and slip parameter on the flow field and heat transfer.
the present work is the first attempt for the transient MHD flow of a vis-co-elastic fluid past a vertical plate embedded in a rotating system with Hall current and heat source.
the Hall current and the slip condition at the plate are the main factors that affect the flow of the visco-elastic liquid and the heat transfer rate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the skin friction and the Nusselt number decrease with the increase in the Hall current parameter.
the velocity and the temperature of the fluid are increased when the magnetic parameter, the Hall current parameter, the Prandtl number and the permeability parameter are increased.

the Hall current, magnetic parameter, and the rotation parameter have a destabilizing influence on velocity and temperature profiles, while the slip parameter and the porosity parameter have a stabilizing influence.
